prompt.full_prompt:
Toy hydraulic model only — no jack or lifting instructions.

Two connected water balloons have different-sized flat plates on top. Which sentence is best?
A) The fluid creates energy from nowhere.
B) Pressure transfers through the fluid, and different areas can change force/motion tradeoffs.
C) The bigger plate is stronger because it feels like it.

Pick one and say what is being transferred.
